[operator-attested] Pause-point stocktake after Gerrit 1811 merged (2026-08-15). The clean post-RAM-revert full-route sample is N=3: runs 31874837464=1,751s (29m11s), 31877824113=1,671s (27m51s), and 31883105646=1,288s (21m28s). Mean=1,570s=26m10s; median=27m51s; range=21m28s–29m11s. All three are below 30 minutes, unlike the prior clean-five mean 31m28.8s. This proves the observed post-revert sample mean is inside the 20–30m target, but only run 31883105646 includes the final build-provenance fixture optimization, so steady-state current-main average remains N=1 and the overall objective is not being declared complete yet. No control-only run was created.

Latest full run 31883105646: end-to-end 21m28s; macOS job 19m45s, default 999.20s and integration 104.84s; Ubuntu jobs py3.11=6m26s, py3.12=10m37s, py3.13+coverage=13m19s. Current Ubuntu default+integration phase occupancy is 1,629.21s=27m09s versus the original 2,066s=34m26s baseline, freeing 436.79s=7m17s per Verify run, a baseline-normalized 21.1% reduction without another runner or any coverage loss. Latest successful-job occupancy is 3,648s=60m48s total: four pytest matrix jobs 3,007s=50m07s, of which Ubuntu is 1,822s=30m22s and macOS 1,185s=19m45s.

No individual test exceeded 30s on any cell. The only test above 20s was macOS integration test_benchmark_commit_count_is_ceil_per_pass at 21.43s; the slowest macOS default call was 13.20s. Operations above 30s were fully attributed on perfect-nondeadly-shrimp: the four default suites, four integration tiers, optional-extras install 75s, complexity-baseline lock 59s, and whole-store identity mount 48s.

Gerrit 1811 preserved every platform/Python cell, selector, worker count, timeout, assertion, coverage and mutation gate while halving its selected-six local package-build replay (18.23s→9.11s) and reducing per-worker setup 56–67%. Run 31883105646 passed LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, exact wheel/sdist patchset provenance, and zero unresolved comments; completion verifier signed PASS and perfect-nondeadly-shrimp is closed.

Remaining dispositions at the pause: (1) gather organic current-main full routes before treating the 26m10s N=3 post-revert mean—or the 21m28s N=1 fully-current result—as the durable average; (2) ravenous-beribboned-walleye remains open because its 21.43s import node is dominated by 24 contractually required Git add/commit boundaries and no fidelity-preserving remediation is proven; (3) panpsychic-clever-hawk remains non-consensus at the implementation level despite direction-level OSS precedent, so no approved change is being inferred; (4) no further optimization patch or CI run is being started at this pause point.
